ember.$description: Ember — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, full-bleed backgrounds, image surrounds

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surfaces, elevated panels, the one step up from canvas

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, secondary labels, inactive UI — sits at AA contrast against Obsidian

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders on dark cards, light surface alternates if used

snow.$description: Snow — Primary text and headings on dark, inverse text on light cards

suisse.$description: The only typeface. Single weight (400) used for everything from 10px micro-labels to 80px display headlines. The signature move is the display at 80px with a 0.70 line-height — headlines feel carved rather than set. Tracking is tight at display (-0.0070em) and slightly open (+0.0060em) at caption sizes for legibility.
